explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this is one of the rivers of the underworld, across which Charon ferries the dead.

explanation.definitionFit: In Homer's Odyssey, Odysseus's loyal swineherd is the first to shelter him on his return to Ithaca.

clue.text: Hooligan figured in this O'Brien book

explanation.definitionFit: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo was the great Venetian painter of ceiling and wall frescoes in the 18th century.
